item.question: Why might a custom tempering schedule be necessary for poorly conditioned target distributions?
item.answer: A custom tempering schedule can improve convergence when a target distribution is poorly conditioned relative to the proposal distribution because it allows for adjustments that better accommodate the specific characteristics of the target's geometry.
